title: A Saint's Bones
text: Diggers in the old crypts have found a saint's bones in a lead box, still smelling of myrrh after five hundred Years. The diggers will not touch it again. The box was nailed shut from the inside, and the inside of the lid is scored with fingernails.

outcomes.text: Pilgrims come, and the city sleeps easier. The priests do not say that the bones are in a different order each morning.

options.label: Sell them to the church across the river.

outcomes.text: The church across the river pays well. Their bell has not rung since.

options.label: Give them to one House to keep.

outcomes.text: One House's chapel holds them, and the others mutter. At night the box is warm.
